Letterkenny

Written on February 10th, 2026 by James Reynolds

Letterkenny hub

The Letterkenny hub was launched on September 5th, 2025.

Sign up

Location

The hub is located centrally on Justice Walsh Road, close to the intersection with Kinnear Lane. The hub is immediately outside the Letterkenny Primary Care Centre, an 11 minute walk from the Letterkenny Shopping Centre on Port Road, and around a 15 minute walk from the Letterkenny University Hospital or the ATU campus.
